items.prompt:
Combining several media sources into one understanding is to:
A) integrate them
B) ignore them
C) delete them

How trustworthy a source is is its:
A) credibility
B) length
C) font

A mismatch between two sources' numbers is a:
A) discrepancy
B) citation
C) rhyme

You have a chart, a video report, and a written study on one issue. To make a decision, you should:
A) integrate and weigh all three
B) use only the chart
C) ignore the study
items.answer: A) integrate and weigh all three

solution.answer: A) integrate and weigh all three

items.prompt:
The chart's numbers don't match the study's figures. You should:
A) note the discrepancy and investigate which is accurate
B) pick the bigger number
C) ignore both
items.answer: A) note the discrepancy and investigate which is accurate

solution.answer: A) note the discrepancy and investigate which is accurate

items.prompt:
To judge a source's CREDIBILITY, check:
A) the author's expertise, the organization, and its accuracy and currency
B) its color
C) its word count only
items.answer: A) the author's expertise, the organization, and its accuracy and currency

solution.answer: A) the author's expertise, the organization, and its accuracy and currency

items.prompt:
An anonymous infographic's statistic contradicts a government agency's report. The MORE credible source is:
A) the government agency's report
B) the anonymous infographic
C) impossible to judge

The main benefit of INTEGRATING multiple media sources is to:
A) make a better-informed decision than any one source allows
B) make the work longer
C) avoid judging sources
items.answer: A) make a better-informed decision than any one source allows

solution.answer: A) make a better-informed decision than any one source allows
